title: Chat attachments: images, files and deep research reports
notes: read now lists chat attachments as markers ([image-01], [report-01], [file-01]).
--files-inline puts deep research report and file text directly into the transcript.
--files-output <dir> downloads every attachment (images included) and links each marker; --file-id <id> downloads a single one.
read hard-reloads the chat before scraping so the 'Files in chat' panel is never stale.
Skipped downloads are reported on stderr and the resolved directory is echoed as filesOutputDir.
